text:
amanda: Short sync  we need a minimal, consistent error payload so SDKs can expose typed exceptions and sample apps can show friendly copy without leaking internals.
jason: Agree. Mobile teams want tiny responses by default. Idea: default compact shape + optional verbose via header `X-Err-Detail: full`.
priya: Proposed canonical fields: `code` (namespaced), `status` (int), `internal_detail` (string), `user_facing` (string, <140 chars), `action_hint` (string), `retryable` (bool|null), `retry_after` (sec|null), `docs` (url).
lucas: Important: add `action_hint` (e.g., "refresh", "retry", "contact") so UIs can map to buttons; prevents heuristic hacks. Also prefer `retryable` explicit boolean so SDKs don't guess.
emily: UX rule: always show `user_facing`; show `internal_detail` only in verbose mode or in an expandable details section. Keeps onboarding calm.
ben: SDKs should parse into typed errors (e.g., RateLimitError) with fields and a helper `shouldRetry()` that obeys `retryable` when present; otherwise fall back to: 429 -> retry, 5xx -> retry, 4xx -> no retry.
amanda: Example verbose payload for docs: {"error": {"code":"quota.rate_exceeded","status":429,"internal_detail":"100 requests/min exceeded for key x","user_facing":"Too many requests, please wait a few seconds.","action_hint":"retry","retryable":true,"retry_after":10,"docs":"https://docs.redwood.ai/errors#quota.rate_exceeded"}}
jason: Compact response (default) should be: {"error":{"code":"quota.rate_exceeded","status":429,"retry_after":10}} to save bytes.
priya: DevEx will add a small parity test set: canonical responses -> expected typed class + expected `shouldRetry()` boolean. We'll run across go/py/js.
lucas: Noted: go SDK CI failing earlier because it treated 401 as retryable in one branch. Add unit tests asserting 401 -> not retryable by default.
ci-bot: CI alert: sample-apps/test-suite failed on sdk-go error-parity test. https://ci.redwood.internal/job/4321
emily: I'll wire the sample app to read `action_hint` -> CTA label mapping (refresh -> "Sign in", retry -> "Retry", contact -> "Contact support").
amanda: Action items: Priya open API PR to add `user_facing`, `action_hint`, `retryable`, and header support; DevEx add parity tests & sample-app mapping; SDK leads implement typed errors + compact/verbose handling. Aim to land API change this week.
priya: Opening PR now, tagging reviewers.
jason: I'll add the parity harness tests to CI matrix.
amanda: Thanks all  keep updates here.
